scope: Coordinator refutation of the two independent motion-review findings.

findings.attempt: Inspected native walk, enemy-active and incoming-reaction images and checked whether the symptom was only a clipped sample, hit effect or old ribbon.
findings.result: The mannequin-like forms persist away from the hit effect. Geometry versus shading remains unproven until neutral-material ablation.

findings.attempt: Traced HUD, Effects, Combat and Player event paths and executed real Player.onDamage and Effects._onDamageTaken methods with observed incoming/outgoing payloads.
findings.result: HUD already filters non-player entities. Effects applied pulseDamage to enemy damage events. Player returned true after reducing health without emitting damage-taken, so Combat suppressed the actual player event. The observed cue reversal is reproduced.

overall: SCOPED_FAIL: both major symptoms survive. R17-MOTION-002 is the next bounded repair; R17-MOTION-001 follows after its neutral-material diagnosis.
